changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Taxonomy columns on inspections. category is the top-level grouping (SAFETY / QA_QC / COMPLIANCE / OTHER) the UI and reporting filter on, and is indexed for that reason; trade is the QA/QC construction stage, populated only for QA/QC (and optionally OTHER) rows. type is left untouched and keeps working as the finer label. Existing rows take the OTHER default here and are moved to their real category by the backfill in the next changeset.

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Derive category from the existing type for every row created before the column existed. safety maps to SAFETY, compliance to COMPLIANCE, and the seven quality and progress types to QA_QC, which covers all nine members of InspectionType, so no row keeps the OTHER default by accident. Each statement is guarded on the row still holding the default, making this a backfill rather than an overwrite.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE inspections SET category = 'SAFETY' WHERE type = 'SAFETY' AND category = 'OTHER'
UPDATE inspections SET category = 'COMPLIANCE' WHERE type = 'COMPLIANCE' AND category = 'OTHER'
UPDATE inspections SET category = 'QA_QC' WHERE type IN ('QUALITY', 'STRUCTURAL', 'ELECTRICAL', 'PLUMBING', 'FINISHING', 'PROGRESS', 'FINAL') AND category = 'OTHER'

changeSet.author: echno
changeSet.comment: Clear whitespace-only severity and status before the enum promotion below, so a blank string is treated as "not recorded" rather than as an unmappable value. severity is nullable and becomes NULL; status carries the OPEN default the entity has always applied.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE inspection_defects SET severity = NULL WHERE severity IS NOT NULL AND trim(severity) = ''
UPDATE inspection_defects SET status = 'open' WHERE status IS NULL OR trim(status) = ''

changeSet.author: echno

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM inspection_defects WHERE severity IS NOT NULL AND upper(replace(replace(trim(severity), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) NOT IN ('CRITICAL', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR')

changeSet.comment: Rewrite the free-text severity as the DefectSeverity constant name that @Enumerated(STRING) reads. Matching is case-insensitive and tolerates hyphens, underscores and spaces; already-normalised values map to themselves, so the statement is idempotent. The precondition halts the migration if any row holds a value outside the three severities rather than dropping it or guessing a bucket for it, which would silently corrupt the row.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE inspection_defects SET severity = upper(replace(replace(trim(severity), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) WHERE severity IS NOT NULL AND upper(replace(replace(trim(severity), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) IN ('CRITICAL', 'MAJOR', 'MINOR')

changeSet.author: echno

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM inspection_defects WHERE status IS NOT NULL AND upper(replace(replace(trim(status), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) NOT IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'VERIFIED')

changeSet.comment: The same promotion for status, against the four DefectStatus members. The precondition halts on any value outside them for the same reason as the severity changeset above.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE inspection_defects SET status = upper(replace(replace(trim(status), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) WHERE status IS NOT NULL AND upper(replace(replace(trim(status), '-', '_'), ' ', '_')) IN ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'RESOLVED', 'VERIFIED')
